subject: Support ecosystem renewal — alignment on coexistence vs consolidation
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 timeline: support ecosystem renewal — framing & asks

Team —

We have three renewal touchpoints coming up in Q3: Intercom (messaging/conv), Gainsight (CS platform), and Zendesk (ticketing). Given overlapping capabilities and upcoming product integrations, I sketched three paths and a short ask below:

Options (high level):
- Renew everything with negotiated discounts (low migration risk, higher short-term cost)
- Consolidate support on Zendesk + Gainsight for CS (remove Intercom or limit to product messaging)
- Coexistence + integration (keep current vendors but invest in SSO/workflow integrations to reduce friction)

Key asks for next week:
1) TCO numbers (license + integration + training) for 12/24 months for each option — Marcus
2) Integration effort estimates and critical gaps (Auth, user mapping, ticket/CS sync) — Aditya
3) Customer-facing impact assessment and recommended pilot approach — Irene/Laura

I've attached a starter pricing_comparison_q3.xlsx with the renewal dates and current seats. Let's use this thread to collect vendor responses and decide an internal recommendation by 2027-07-22.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior Manager, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 timeline: support ecosystem renewal — framing & asks

Thanks, Monica — good framing. A couple of clarifications:

- Timeline constraint: procurement needs firm decisions for any seat changes by 2027-08-10 to meet contract termination/renewal windows.
- Customer risk: we cannot break or degrade the NPS survey pipeline (Gainsight) during any migration; that is non-negotiable.

Marcus/Aditya — please push your TCO/integration estimates into the shared sheet by EOD Monday (2027-07-05).

I'll loop vendor reps into the thread after we have the internal numbers so they can respond with concrete commercial offers and a list of required engineering tasks.

One small ask for the vendor phase: include a standard migration playbook or sample SOW with estimated days and named roles (project mgr, engineer, data migration specialist).

Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Martin <sophie@intercom.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julien Lefevre <julien@zendesk.com>, Rajesh Kumar <rkumar@gainsight.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@vendors.redwood-intl.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 11:41:00 -0700
Subject: Intercom initial commercial — coexistence option

Hi team —

Thanks for the heads up, Monica/Irene. Quick note from Intercom on the coexistence path:

- We can offer a 20% renewal discount if you commit to a 12-month renewal and a 6-month pilot on our advanced routing add-on (we think it reduces triage time for CS by ~22%).
- Integration: we provide an official connector for Gainsight that syncs conversations -> health score events; engineering estimate ~6-8 days (one full-time SWE + config).
- Playbook: attaching a one-page migration checklist and linking the full proposal here: https://intercom.com/proposals/rw-2027-07 (proposal includes named roles and timeline).

Attachments: intercom_feature_map.png, intercom_coexist_playbook.pdf (link above).

Happy to schedule a 30-minute walkthrough next week.

Best,
Sophie Martin
Enterprise Solutions
Intercom

On Mon, Jul 12, 2027 at 10:25 AM, Rajesh Kumar <rkumar@gainsight.com> wrote:

> Hi all —
>
> Appreciate the conversation. From Gainsight's side:
> - We support coexistence but want to emphasize the data model alignment work (user identity, account mapping, event schemas). Rough estimate: 12-15 engineering days including QA for full bi-directional sync.
> - Pricing: we can offer 15% off renewal and include a one-time migration services credit (up to 40 hours).
> - SOW: see draft_SOW_Gainsight_v2.pdf attached with named roles and milestones.
>
> Two asks for the internal team: a current list of events sent from Intercom to Gainsight and the canonical user id you plan to use for cross-system joins.
>
> If you want, we can run a joint workshop with Intercom on July 20 to scope the integration tasks.

Thanks,

Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Support ecosystem renewal — next steps and decision path

Thanks everyone for the proposals and quick turnarounds. Short update and decision path: 

1) Internal TCO and integration estimates are in the shared sheet (see links). High level: coexistence + targeted integrations has the best risk/cost balance for 12 months; consolidation to a single vendor would require an additional 6–9 months of migration work and higher immediate admin overhead.
2) Procurement action: please prepare contract addenda for the coexistence path for both Intercom and Gainsight with the discount and migration credit terms discussed. Procurement, can you confirm a timeline to receive redlines? (Procurement Team)
3) Pilot/workshop: schedule a joint workshop July 27–29 to finalize the integration scope (Monica to coordinate).

Attachments referenced above (pricing_comparison_q3.xlsx, draft_SOW_Gainsight_v2.pdf).

We will review contract addenda and aim to lock commercial terms by 2027-08-05 to meet the renewal windows. If there are major commercial blockers, escalate to me and Marcus.

Irene Choi
Head of Platform Partnerships
Redwood Inference
